Manifest.Name: Next Opening: Suppliers & Odin
Manifest.Author: NextOpeningVisitors
Manifest.Description: 中文：下一次开店优先到访、预约去重与冷却清除；交易和调查预测、自动清除来电、物品高亮、放大镜鉴定、荧光莓品质标志及身份提醒。新增 2 点开局特性“夜猫子”：夜间不限外出次数，同一地点每晚一次，兼容其他 Mod 的原生外出地点。按 F8 打开 13 项独立功能开关。 English: Next-opening visits, appointment deduplication, cooldown clearing, forecasts, cleanup calls, highlights, appraisals, Glowberry quality markers and identity alerts. New 2-point Night Owl perk: unlimited nightly outings, one visit per location per night, including locations from other mods using the native system. Press F8 for 13 independent feature toggles.
